# iru_custom_profile (Resource)

Manages one Iru Custom Profile Library Item with explicit target platforms. Does not manage assignments or device inventory. Import by Library Item UUID.

Provide unsigned XML plist content and explicitly enable at least one supported
`runs_on_*` platform. All target flags and `active` default to false. Signed
binary profiles and Android/Windows write fields are outside this resource's
scope. XML is checked for syntax and a single plist root; Iru validates the actual
MDM payload. External entities are not fetched. Content is not arbitrarily
reformatted: whitespace inside XML string/data values can be meaningful.
Read/import requires complete target metadata for all five managed platforms;
missing/null flags produce a diagnostic rather than an inferred false value.

Create/content changes send a multipart mobileconfig file. Metadata-only updates
omit the file. Profile contents remain in Terraform state despite sensitive
display flags; protect state and avoid embedded credentials. Destroy permanently
deletes the Library Item and can affect assignments managed elsewhere.

Writes are never replayed automatically. A valid returned UUID is retained after
a malformed create response. Terraform can mark failed creation tainted; verify
the actual item and configuration before deliberately recovering state. Real
tenant permissions, XML normalization and platform behavior require live
acceptance validation.

## Example Usage


```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Synthetic XML only; replace with a validated profile before real use.
resource "iru_custom_profile" "example" {
  name        = "Synthetic profile example"
  profile     = "<plist version=\"1.0\"><dict><key>PayloadDisplayName</key><string>Synthetic example</string></dict></plist>"
  active      = false
  runs_on_mac = true
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `profile` (String, Sensitive) Unsigned XML plist content sent as a mobileconfig file. Stored verbatim in Terraform state; do not embed secrets.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the Library Item is active. Defaults to false.
- `runs_on_ipad` (Boolean) Target iPad. Defaults to false; choose at least one supported platform.
- `runs_on_iphone` (Boolean) Target iPhone. Defaults to false; choose at least one supported platform.
- `runs_on_mac` (Boolean) Target macOS. Defaults to false; choose at least one supported platform.
- `runs_on_tv` (Boolean) Target Apple TV. Defaults to false; choose at least one supported platform.
- `runs_on_vision` (Boolean) Target Apple Vision. Defaults to false; choose at least one supported platform.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Library Item UUID.
- `mdm_identifier` (String) MDM identifier returned by Iru.

## Import

Import by Library Item UUID. Use the returned XML content and explicitly match
all active/platform settings for a no-op plan. Omitted defaults can deactivate
or retarget an imported profile. Inspect the plan before applying.


```shell
#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Synthetic UUID: replace with the existing Library Item ID.
terraform import iru_custom_profile.example 11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555
```
